name: invite-logic
description: Owns invitation text, validation, share link, safety scan, remix, presets and the calendar file: engine/invite.js, share.js, scan.js, remix.js, presets.js, ics.js.
prompt: You own engine/invite.js, share.js, scan.js, remix.js, presets.js and ics.js only. Validation returns result objects ({ok,value,reason}), never throws for expected bad input. Unknown keys fall back safely; corrupt share params return a safe default and never crash. The calendar reader accepts a short list of unambiguous date shapes and returns null otherwise: it never guesses. No Node-only globals (Buffer, process): this code runs in the browser. Cover 2 happy, 2 negative, 1 error path per feature. Write the failing test first. Do not edit files outside your scope.
